$comment: Agent registry. Adding an agent is one entry plus a stdio loop - see docs/add-an-agent.md. Paths are relative to the repository root.

scripted.description: Hand-written deterministic flow. The calibration ceiling: if this cannot pass a task, the task is broken.

flaky.description: The scripted flow with seeded per-step input errors it does not notice. Reproduces the pass^k collapse with no model and no API key.

compiled.description: Replays a flow compiled from a successful trace, falling back to abstention on UI drift. Reads the committed flows in results/flows; override with BELLWETHER_FLOW_DIR.

claude-cua.description: Reference computer-use agent: Claude Opus 5, vision only, structured-output actions. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and costs money per step.

claude-cua-scripted.description: The same agent with a canned model. Verifies the whole Python agent through the real harness with no key and no spend; only solves sim-cust-01.
